title: Profile record (prof_…)
description: What an organization wants of an environment of a given kind (glossary: Profile; R10, decision 15): constraints by kind, and which kinds may be shared between needs (decision 28). A plate pins its profile by content address, so a profile can never change under a plate. Unsigned.

name.description: `production`, `minimal-cost-dev`. Testimony; the address is the identity.

constraints.description: For each kind named, a predicate every serving of that kind must satisfy, conjoined with each need's own constraints (R14). Kinds not named are unconstrained by the profile.

sharing.description: Whether one serving of this kind may cover several needs. A kind not listed is NOT shareable: the safe default.
